title: Named retro games discovery
summary: Review five projects for Bloodwych, Nebulus, Neuromancer and Head over Heels.
notes: Personally reviewed pinned upstream READMEs and checked current catalogue search; no independent builds or binary comparisons.

sources.reason: A browser viewer for raw Atari ST graphics, informed by Bloodwych-68k research, and 8SVX sound playback; not a game reconstruction.
An incomplete native Windows reconstruction recovering CPC data and translating selected game rules; the author calls it a technical prototype, not a full replica.
Native 68K Macintosh adaptation based on the Apple IIGS game, with monochrome and colour editions; byte-exact reconstruction is not established.
Java cleanroom replacement for the DOS game engine, using original game data and asset decoding adapted from Reuromancer; author describes it as late alpha.
Small Unity deconstruction of Nebulus tower brickwork; not a complete game disassembly or engine reconstruction. The inspected README does not identify a specific original platform.
